public_naming_rule: Figures, tables, and canonical publication CSVs use only Baseline B and Structured fusion.
archived_machine_identifier_note: The frozen evaluation source and audit records retain Structured-R2 as the machine identifier for the modified Structured fusion implementation. It is not a third method.
implementation_disclosure: The Structured fusion implementation was modified after the earlier result, selected using development/validation data, frozen before the once-only final evaluation, and is reported as post-hoc exploratory.
capacity_disclosure: Baseline B used 56 input features, 4,012 fitted parameters, and 50 epochs; Structured fusion used 145 input features, 29,156 fitted parameters, and 80 epochs. The comparison is not capacity- or optimization-budget-matched and does not isolate fusion alone.

validation.raw_recomputation: All ten endpoints and intervals were recomputed from archived raw rows.
validation.checkpoint_replay: All 20 checkpoints reloaded and reproduced fixed-test and rollout logits.

evidence_boundary: No CARLA server, public-dataset benchmark, real-vehicle record, or empirical LLM output was used. Rollout endpoints are controlled-synthetic proxies and are not deployment-safety evidence.
